title: Unrecognised connected app performing bulk CRM export
rule_name: SAAS-SF-0117: Connected app bulk API export exceeding baseline
detection_source: SaaS posture monitoring, corroborated by a helpdesk report

connected_app.name: Data Loader
connected_app.note: Name matches the legitimate Salesforce Data Loader, but the consumer key does not match the tenant's approved app inventory.

reported_by.summary: User called the service desk to ask whether the 'IT security team' should have needed her to approve an app on the Salesforce login screen. No engineer had contacted her.

detail: A connected app named 'Data Loader' was authorised against the production Salesforce org at 12:58 UTC from a Mullvad VPN exit node, then exported 1,204,719 records across five objects in 43 minutes using Bulk API 2.0 — roughly 287× the tenant's daily baseline. The authorising user reports she was walked through the authorisation over the phone by a caller claiming to be internal IT, who cited a 'mandatory data-integrity check' and read out a verification code. The consumer key is not in the approved app inventory. No endpoint malware alerted; the entire chain is SaaS-native and would not appear in EDR telemetry.
